How to Download the EMRS Tier-II Result 2026

Sources describe two different ways to access the result a direct PDF download and a login-based portal check. Both methods are listed below since they are not corroborated against each other; candidates should try the official website first to confirm which applies.

Method 1: Direct PDF Download

  1. Visit the official website nests.tribal.gov.in or examinationservices.nic.in.
  2. Look for the link titled "EMRS Tier-II Result 2026 (Principal Post)."
  3. Open the result PDF and use Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  4. Download and save the file, and take a printout for your records.

Method 2: Login-Based Check

  1. Visit the official result portal link on nests.tribal.gov.in.
  2. Log in using your Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth.
  3. View your qualifying status and score details after logging in.

Documents Required After Qualifying the Tier-II Result

  • Identity proof: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Voter ID
  • Educational documents: Class 10 and 12 mark sheets, degree certificates, postgraduate transcripts
  • Professional certificates: B.Ed degree or relevant teaching diploma, where applicable
  • Valid category/caste certificate, where applicable
  • Tier-II Admit Card and a saved/printed copy of the EMRS Tier-II Result 2026

What Happens After the EMRS Tier-II Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify move to the next selection stage. Reported next steps differ slightly between sources, so both are listed below.

  • Document Verification (DV) for all shortlisted candidates
  • Personal interview, specifically for candidates applying to the Principal post
  • Skill Test/Practical Test, for posts where applicable

EMRS Tier-II Result 2026: Important Instructions

  • Only the Principal post result has been declared as of 3 September 2026 results for other posts are Not Yet Announced.
  • Keep your roll number, registration number, and date of birth handy, since result-check methods reported differ (direct PDF search vs. login-based check).
  • If the official result link does not load immediately, retry after some time rather than assuming an error.
  • The cutoff marks listed in this article are an unofficial, estimated range refer to the official cutoff document on the NESTS website once released.
  • Cross-check post-wise eligibility, application fee, and selection-process details against the official EMRS notification, as some of these figures come from a single aggregator source in this article.

Punjab National Bank (PNB) has released the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 for candidates who appeared in the Local Bank Officer (LBO) online written examination held on 4 January 2026. The individual scorecard link went live on the official recruitment page on 1 August 2026 and can be accessed through a registration-based login on the ibpsreg.ibps.in portal. This article explains how to download your scorecard, what it contains, the qualifying marks, and the last date to access it.

Direct Link to Check PNB LBO Score Card 2026

Joining Schedule – Second and Final Opportunity 29 July 2026

Scorecard Download Window Closes 31 August 2026, 11:55 PM

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

Also Read: UP TGT 2026 Special Document Verification Admit Card

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

PNB LBO Written Exam Qualifying Marks (Cut Off)

As reported by exam-preparation portals covering this recruitment cycle, candidates were required to clear both an overall cut off and a minimum sectional cut off in the online written test:

Category Minimum Marks Required Per Section
General / EWS 40%
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD 35%

Note: These sectional cut off percentages are drawn from exam-reporting sources and are consistent with the standard IBPS-pattern cut off structure used in this recruitment; they are Not Available Officially as an explicitly stated figure on PNB's own notice text reviewed for this article. Candidates should cross-check exact figures against their own scorecard.

Separately, some exam-prep sources report an interview qualifying score of 25 out of 50 for General category candidates and 22.5 out of 50 for SC/ST candidates. This detail is Not Available Officially on PNB's recruitment notice board and should be treated as unconfirmed until verified against the official result document.

  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Driving License, etc.)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Proof of post-qualification banking experience (as applicable to the LBO eligibility criteria)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Also Read: UPSSSC VDO Supplementary Result 2026

Important Instructions

  • The scorecard link is active only for a limited window (1 August to 31 August 2026). Download it before the window closes.
  • Use your registration number rather than your name to search for your record, since candidate names can repeat.
  • Report any discrepancy in personal details on the scorecard to PNB/IBPS immediately rather than proceeding with an incorrect document.
  • PNB has issued a public notice warning candidates against paying any money to anyone for interview calls, selection, or appointment. The bank does not charge any fee for these purposes.
  • Keep your scorecard along with your final result document for document verification and joining formalities.

As per the notice, the SBI CBO interview will be held from 13 July 2026 to 19 July 2026. If you're one of the shortlisted candidates, this is your final step before securing a role as a Circle Based Officer at SBI so let's walk through everything you need to know: where to download the call letter, what documents to carry, and how the final selection is calculated.

SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026 - Quick Overview

This section summarizes the most important facts about the SBI CBO 2026 interview round in one place, so you can quickly confirm the key dates and numbers without scrolling through the entire article.

What Is the SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026?

Before downloading your admit card, it helps to understand exactly what this document is and why it matters for the recruitment process. The SBI CBO Interview Call Letter is the official admission ticket that confirms a candidate has cleared the earlier stages and is now eligible to appear for the personal interview round.

The interview call letter is a mandatory document for the SBI CBO Recruitment 2026 drive, which is being conducted to fill 2,050 vacancies for the Circle Based Officer post across various states and language zones. Without this call letter, candidates will not be permitted entry into the interview venue, so downloading and verifying it well in advance is essential.

SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026: Download Link

This section explains exactly where and how you can access your call letter online, along with what to do immediately after downloading it.

Candidates can download the SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026 through the official recruitment portal. Once downloaded, cross-check every detail printed on it including your interview date, reporting time, and venue address and keep both a printed copy and a digital backup ready ahead of interview day.

Login Credentials Required to Download the Call Letter

To successfully access your call letter, you'll need specific login credentials that were created during your application process. This section lists exactly what you need to have on hand.

You will need the following details to log in to the portal:

  • Registration Number or Roll Number (generated at the time of application/exam)
  • Password or Date of Birth (as set/used during registration)

Since these credentials were generated earlier in the recruitment cycle, candidates who have misplaced them should retrieve their registration details before the download window gets busy closer to the interview dates.

How to Download SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026: Step-by-Step

If you're downloading your call letter for the first time, this simple step-by-step guide will help you complete the process without errors.

  1. Visit the official SBI website or the direct download link provided above.
  2. Navigate to the "Careers" section (if accessing via sbi.co.in).
  3. Click on the SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026 link.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Click submit to view your call letter.
  6. Download the PDF and take a clear printout for the interview day.

Details Mentioned on the SBI CBO Interview Call Letter

Your call letter contains critical information you must verify immediately after downloading. This section breaks down exactly what's printed on the document.

The SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026 includes:

  • Candidate's name and roll number
  • Interview date and reporting time
  • Interview venue name and complete address
  • Important day-of instructions and guidelines

If any detail such as your name, photograph, or center address appears incorrect, contact the SBI recruitment cell or IBPS helpline immediately for correction.

Documents to Carry for the SBI CBO Interview 2026

Carrying the correct set of documents is non-negotiable for interview-day entry. This section lists everything you must bring along.

  • A printed copy of the interview call letter
  • A valid original photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID, etc.)
  • Original and photocopies of educational certificates and mark sheets
  • Recent passport-size photographs (the same one used during application, if specified)

Candidates should keep all documents organized in a single folder to avoid last-minute confusion at the venue.

SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

Understanding how your final selection is calculated helps you prepare strategically for the interview. This section explains the complete selection methodology for SBI CBO 2026.

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

  1. Online Examination - The first screening stage testing candidates' aptitude and knowledge.
  2. Screening/Shortlisting - Candidates are shortlisted based on online exam performance for the interview stage.
  3. Interview - Worth 50 marks, assessing banking awareness, professional knowledge, and communication skills.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the regional/local language relevant to their applied state or circle.

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

  • Online Examination: 75% weightage
  • Interview: 25% weightage

This means strong performance in the online exam significantly boosts your overall chances, but a good interview score remains essential for the final cutoff.

Selected Circle Based Officers will receive a starting basic pay of ₹48,480, along with 2 advance increments, as per the official SBI CBO notification. For a full salary breakup including allowances and in-hand pay, refer to the SBI CBO Salary details.

Candidates can now download their hall ticket from the official website using their registration number and password or date of birth. The Central Bank of India Apprentice Exam 2026 is scheduled for 5th July 2026 (Sunday) and will be conducted by BFSI SSC in online computer-based test mode. CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

The Central Bank of India has announced a total of 4,500 Apprentice vacancies for the financial year 2026-27, distributed across various states and union territories. Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh reportedly have the largest state-wise allocations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF on the bank's recruitment page for the exact state-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup, since detailed figures for every state were not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Category Age Relaxation

SC / ST 5 years

Candidates should check the official notification for the exact category-wise age relaxation applicable to them.

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original government-issued photo ID proof, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence
  • A photocopy of the photo ID for verification
  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

How to Download the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Follow these steps to download your Central Bank of India Apprentice hall ticket:

  1. Visit the official website of the Central Bank of India at centralbankofindia.co.in or centralbank.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Recruitment" or "Careers" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the "CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026" or "Download Call Letter" link.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password or Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code, if required.
  6. Click the Login or Submit button.
  7. Your CBI Apprentice Hall Ticket 2026 will appear on the screen.
  8. Carefully verify all details, including your name, photograph, signature, exam date, and exam centre.
  9. Download the admit card and take a clear printout on an A4 sheet for the examination.

Central Bank of India Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The online written examination consists of 100 objective-type questions worth 100 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes, with no negative marking.

Subject Questions Marks Medium

Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude 20 20 English/Hindi
Computer Knowledge 20 20 English/Hindi
General English 20 20 English
Central Bank of India Products & Services 20 20 English
Total 100 100 -

Important Instructions for Exam Day

  • Reach the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on your individual admit card.
  • Carry the printed admit card; digital copies on a phone or tablet are typically not accepted.
  • Do not carry prohibited items such as mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, bags, or study material into the exam hall.
  • Check your name, photograph, exam centre address, and category details on the admit card, and report any discrepancy to the helpdesk immediately.
  • Wear simple clothing and avoid accessories like jewellery or metal items, as per standard exam-day dress code guidelines followed by the bank.

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the official notification for SSC JE Recruitment 2026, inviting online applications for the Junior Engineer (JE) Examination, 2026. SSC JE Vacancy 2026

SSC has notified 1748 tentative vacancies for the Junior Engineer Examination 2026. These vacancies are spread across multiple Central Government organizations and posts, including JE (Civil), JE (Electrical), JE (Mechanical), JE (Electrical & Mechanical), JE (Telecom), and Scientific Assistant in IMD.

The organization-wise and category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD) vacancy break-up is not fixed in the notice itself - SSC has stated that the final, post-wise and category-wise vacancy details will be published separately on its website under "For Candidates > Tentative Vacancy." State-wise or zone-wise vacancy figures are not maintained by SSC; candidates are advised to check with the concerned user department for that information.

Organizations and Posts Covered under SSC JE 2026

The notification lists Junior Engineer and Scientific Assistant posts across the following Central Government organizations/departments. Educational qualification and age limit vary by organization and post - the summary below is indicative; the full post-wise qualification table is available in the official notice.

Refer to Notes 1–4 of the official notice for exact cross-eligibility rules.

SSC JE Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

To apply for SSC JE 2026, candidates must meet the nationality, educational qualification, and age criteria prescribed for the post and organization they are applying to.

Nationality/Citizenship

A candidate must be:

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A subject of Bhutan, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (an eligibility certificate from the Government of India is required for these categories).

Also Read: UPSC EPFO APFC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 80 Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner Posts

SSC JE Qualification

Essential educational qualifications differ by organization and post. Broadly:

  • JE (Civil): Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institute; or a three-year diploma in Civil Engineering plus relevant work experience (requirement varies by organization).
  • JE (Electrical) / JE (Mechanical) / JE (Electrical & Mechanical): Degree or diploma in the relevant Electrical/Mechanical/Automobile engineering discipline from a recognized university/institute, with experience required in some organizations.
  • JE (Telecom): Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical Communications, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or Instrumentation.
  • Scientific Assistant (IMD): Bachelor's degree in Science with Physics as one of the subjects, or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Computer Applications/Electronics/Electronics & Communication Engineering/Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering/Instrumentation/Information Technology/Telecommunication Engineering/Communication Engineering.

Because the exact qualification differs organization by organization (for example, CPWD requires a diploma while BRO accepts a degree or diploma-plus-experience), candidates should check the qualification listed against their target organization in the official notice before applying. Qualifications obtained through Open and Distance Learning (ODL)/online mode in restricted disciplines such as Engineering are not accepted unless specifically permitted under applicable UGC regulations or judicial orders.

Age relaxation is not admissible to sons, daughters, and other dependents of Ex-Servicemen.

  • The fee payment deadline is 23.09.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Fee once paid is not refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination.
  • Applications with unpaid or incomplete fee status are summarily rejected.

SSC JE Salary

Selected candidates will be appointed to Group 'B' posts in Pay Level-6 of the Pay Matrix under the 7th Central Pay Commission, with a pay scale of ₹35,400 – ₹112,400. Actual in-hand salary will also include applicable allowances (such as DA, HRA and TA) as per the rules of the respective recruiting organization, which are not detailed in this notice.

SSC JE Selection Process

Selection for SSC JE 2026 is based on the following stages:

  1. Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) – Qualifying in nature. Covers General Intelligence & Reasoning (50 questions/50 marks), General Awareness (50 questions/50 marks), and the relevant engineering/technical subject based on the post applied for (100 questions/100 marks). Total duration is 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for candidates eligible for a scribe). Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for each wrong answer.
  2. Paper-II (Computer Based Examination) – For candidates shortlisted from Paper-I. Covers the relevant engineering/technical subject in depth (100 questions/300 marks) in 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for scribe-eligible candidates). Negative marking of 1 mark applies for each wrong answer.
  3. Document Verification (DV) – Provisionally selected candidates must produce original certificates (educational qualification, category, age proof, experience, etc.) for verification by the concerned user department/organization.
  4. Physical Standards and Medical Examination – Applicable specifically for posts under organizations such as Border Roads Organisation (BRO)/GREF, as detailed in the relevant annexure of the notice.

Separate merit lists are prepared for JE (Civil), JE (Electrical & Mechanical), Scientific Assistant (IMD), and JE (Telecom). Both papers consist of objective-type, multiple-choice questions set in Hindi and English.

Check SSC JE Syllabus 2026 Here

How to Apply for SSC JE Recruitment 2026

  1. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the SSC website (ssc.gov.in). An OTR already generated on the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid on the new site.
  2. Log in and fill the online application form for the JE Examination 2026, either via the SSC website or the "mySSC" mobile app.
  3. Upload photograph and signature, or opt for Aadhaar-based authentication, which exempts candidates from certain photo/signature format rejections.
  4. Select your organization, post, and relevant subject/stream as per your educational qualification - this choice cannot be changed later.
  5. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) using BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or a Visa/MasterCard/Maestro/RuPay debit card.
  6. Preview and submit the form, and save/print a copy for your records.

Candidates should complete their application well before the closing date, since SSC has stated it will not be responsible for candidates unable to submit due to heavy website traffic near the deadline.

The Department of Posts (India Post), Ministry of Communications, Government of India, has released the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 notification vide Notification No. 17-12/2026-GDS dated 20 August 2026. Applications are invited from eligible candidates to fill tentative vacant posts of Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak in different offices of the Department of Posts across various Circles and Divisions in India. Interested candidates can apply online at the official GDS Online Engagement Portal.

Quick Answer: India Post (Department of Posts) is recruiting for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) posts - Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak - under the Schedule-II, July-2026 engagement cycle. India Post has announced 23,757 tentative vacancies under the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) engagement. Candidates aged 18-40 years who have passed Class 10 (Secondary School Examination) with passing marks in Mathematics and English, and studied the prescribed local language up to 10th standard, can apply. Online One-Time Registration starts 31 August 2026, and online application submission runs from 2 September 2026 to 21 September 2026 (up to 1700 hrs), at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement, for postings in rural offices of the Department of Posts across India.

India Post GDS Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

India Post has announced 23,757 vacancies under the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) engagement. The latest Annexure-Ia provides the vacancy position Circle-wise, local-language-wise and category-wise across India. The vacancies are distributed among UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS and PwBD categories.

The annexure does not provide a separate vacancy breakup for BPM, ABPM and Dak Sevak posts; it gives the consolidated GDS vacancy position by Circle, language and reservation category.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for all GDS posts (BPM/ABPM/Dak Sevak) is assessed as on the date of the notification (for qualification) and the last date of application submission (for age), as detailed below.

Criterion Requirement
Educational Qualification Secondary School Examination (SSE)/10th standard pass certificate, with passing marks in Mathematics and English, from a Board recognized by the Government of India/State Governments/Union Territories. Candidates with equivalent qualification from any other board are not eligible.
Local Language Must have studied the local language (as prescribed post-wise for each Circle in Annexure-III of the notification) at least up to 10th standard from a recognized board. Special provisions apply for Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, Sikkim, and Nagaland.
Other Qualifications Knowledge of computers; knowledge of cycling; and adequate means of livelihood besides the GDS allowances (to be submitted as undertakings at the time of engagement)

Note: Past experience or service of any kind is not considered for selection, as per the notification.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Salary (TRCA)

GDS are not regular Central Government employees; they are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carries an annual increase of 3% (subject to fulfilment of conditions under the GDS Rules), along with Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time. GDS are also entitled to GDS Gratuity and the Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to the National Pension System for regular employees).

Category Initial TRCA Slab
Branch Postmaster (BPM) ₹12,000/- to ₹29,380/-
Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM)/Dak Sevak ₹10,000/- to ₹24,470/-

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

A fee of ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) is payable by applicants for all posts notified in their choice of Division. Payment can be made online through recognized Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI (usage charges as applicable will be levied). The fee, once paid, is non-refundable, and payment must be completed strictly within the application closing date and time (up to 1700 hrs).

  • Fee-exempted categories: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants
  • Applicants who are exempted may submit their application without making any payment

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 40 years, to be determined as on the last date of submission of applications, subject to the following relaxations in the upper age limit.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

There is no written examination for GDS engagement. Selection is entirely merit-based, computed from the candidate's Class 10 (SSE) academic record.

  • Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of a system-generated merit list
  • The merit list is prepared from marks obtained (or grades/points converted to marks) in the Secondary School Examination (10th standard), aggregated to a percentage up to 4 decimal places
  • Where only grades are given, marks are computed using a multiplication factor of 9.5 against the grade point (e.g., A1 = Grade Point 10 × 9.5); where CGPA is given, marks are computed as CGPA × 9.5, and the higher of the two (individual subject grades vs. CGPA) is taken if both are provided
  • Candidates must enter marks/grades exactly as shown on their marksheet - mixing marks and grades incorrectly, or entering grades where marks are required, can lead to cancellation/disqualification
  • Tie-breaking in the merit list follows a fixed priority order based on date of birth (older preferred) followed by category and gender combinations (ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, and so on down the prescribed order), with the Department reserving the right to apply additional tie-breaking criteria
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo physical verification of original documents by the Engaging Authority (Divisional/Unit Head), followed by an offer of provisional engagement, pre-engagement formalities (including 3 days of basic training and arranging accommodation), and final regularization after antecedent and document verification

How to Apply for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, in two stages - One-Time Registration (OTR) followed by the Online Application Form.

  1. Visit the GDS Online Engagement Portal: https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  2. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using a valid mobile number and email ID (verified via OTP), entering personal details and Class 10 board/year of passing information, to generate a unique Registration Number
  3. Log in using the Registration Number and password received via SMS, then click "Apply Online" under the "Active Notification" tab
  4. Fill in Personal Details, Board/Educational Details (Circle, Board Name, passing year, marks obtained), and select Division and post preferences based on eligible vacancies
  5. Upload a recent photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30-100 KB, 320×400 px, 4:5 aspect ratio) and signature (JPG/JPEG, 20-100 KB, 300×120 px, 5:2 aspect ratio) as per prescribed specifications
  6. Preview the application and make any corrections before final submission
  7. Pay the applicable fee (if not exempted) through the available online payment modes within 10 minutes of initiating payment
  8. Submit the application on or before the last date, and use the two-day edit/correction window (23-24 September 2026) if any corrections are needed

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate; multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited and will result in cancellation of candidature
  • Candidates are not required to upload documents with the application, only their photograph and signature; original documents are verified physically at a later stage
  • Name, Date of Birth, Father's name, and Mother's name must be entered exactly as recorded in the Class 10 (Matriculation) certificate, failing which candidature may be cancelled
  • Mobile number and email ID, once registered, cannot be modified under any circumstances
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsorily retired from Government service/GDS in the past as a penalty are barred from applying and must submit an undertaking to this effect
  • SSE marksheets of selected candidates may be verified through DigiLocker/API Setu, and candidates must give consent for this verification
  • Candidates dismissed/removed/retired from Government service in the past as a penalty are barred from applying; a false declaration will lead to termination and possible prosecution
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement
  • The Department does not make phone calls to applicants; all correspondence is through the Engaging Authority only, and applicants should be cautious of unscrupulous calls seeking personal information
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason

PMBI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for PMBI Recruitment 2026 follows a three-stage process:

  1. Initial Screening: The duly filled application form, along with copies of educational and experience documents, is checked and verified against the eligibility criteria for the post applied for.
  2. Written Examination: Screened eligible candidates are called for a written exam based on English language writing skills, subject knowledge related to the post, and general knowledge. No conveyance is paid for appearing in the written exam. Date, time, venue and syllabus are communicated to eligible candidates by email before the exam.
  3. Personal Interaction cum Interview: Candidates who qualify the written exam are called for a Personal Interaction cum Interview. Based on credentials and interview performance, the offer of appointment is issued to suitable candidates in order of merit. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview.

Candidates must carry all original supporting documents (mark sheets, degree certificates, experience certificates, etc.) along with one set of photocopies at the time of the Personal Interaction cum Interview, for verification.

How to Apply for PMBI Recruitment 2026 (PMBI Recruitment 2026 Apply Online)

There is no online application portal mentioned in this PMBI notification. Applications must be submitted as hard copies only, by post or courier - applications sent by email or through any other mode will be rejected.

  1. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.pmbi.co.in/index.aspx
  2. Fill the application form completely, in the prescribed format only.
  3. Attach a recent passport-size photograph (selfies are not accepted).
  4. Attach self-attested copies of age proof (Matriculation Certificate/Aadhar Card/PAN Card/Passport), educational certificates, and experience certificates.
  5. Attach the original Demand Draft of Rs. 100 in favour of "Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)".
  6. Send the complete application by post/courier to: CEO, PMBI, B-500, Tower B, 5th Floor, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi – 110029.
  7. Ensure the application reaches PMBI on or before 24 September 2026, till 5:00 PM.

Reasons Applications Will Be Rejected

  • Not submitted in the prescribed application format, or submitted through email/any other mode.
  • Missing age proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, or the Demand Draft.
  • Application or supporting documents submitted as photocopies/photos instead of originals with the form.
  • Application not clearly visible or not readable.
  • Application received after the last date and time.
  • Incomplete application, missing passport-size photo, or missing Rs. 100 Demand Draft.

PMBI Recruitment 2026: General Terms & Conditions

  • The appointment is purely contractual and does not entitle any candidate to claim regular/permanent employment in PMBI.
  • Selected candidates are liable to be transferred/posted anywhere in India at PMBI's discretion.
  • The initial contract is for 3 years, extendable based on performance; there is a 6-month observation period during the first year.
  • If an employee resigns or abandons service within the first year (including the observation period) or violates appointment terms, liquidated damages equal to 3 months' consolidated pay are payable.
  • During the 6-month observation period, the contract can be terminated by giving 7 days' notice if performance is unsatisfactory.
  • After the observation period, the contract can be terminated by giving 30 days' notice or 30 days' remuneration in lieu thereof.
  • The number of posts may be increased or decreased based on internal department requirements.
  • Candidates are advised to check their email regularly for updates; no TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview.
  • For assistance, candidates may call PMBI on 011-49431800.

Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), India's Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise and flagship energy company, has released the IOCL Recruitment 2026 notification (Advt No. IOCL/CO-HR/RECTT/2026/02 dated 3rd September, 2026) for the recruitment of experienced professionals for its upcoming Poly Butadiene Rubber (PBR) Plant and PBR Business Marketing Group at Panipat. IOCL is inviting applications for 3 posts — Production Manager (Grade C), Senior Production Manager (Grade D), and Senior Manager (PBR-Marketing) (Grade D). Online registration for IOCL Recruitment 2026 starts on 03.09.2026 and closes on 17.09.2026 till 17:00 hrs. Only Indian Nationals with the requisite qualification and experience can apply online through IOCL's official website.

Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) is recruiting experienced professionals for Production Manager, Senior Production Manager, and Senior Manager (PBR-Marketing) posts, with 3 total vacancies (all Unreserved). Only Indian Nationals meeting the qualification, age, and minimum work-experience criteria can apply. Applications open 03.09.2026 and close 17.09.2026 (till 1700 hrs), applications are accepted only in online mode via www.iocl.com, and the posts are for IOCL's upcoming PBR Plant and PBR Business Marketing Group, expected to be based at Panipat.

IOCL has released the detailed advertisement for recruitment of experienced professionals on its official careers page. Candidates are advised to read the full notification carefully before applying online.

IOCL has announced 3 vacancies for its upcoming PBR Plant and PBR Business Marketing Group. All posts are Unreserved and not identified for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) candidates.

IOCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates must fulfil the qualification, age, and minimum work-experience criteria specified below for the post they are applying for. Since all posts are Unreserved, no relaxation or concession in eligibility criteria is extended to any candidate belonging to EWS/OBC(NCL)/SC/ST, although such candidates must still furnish supporting category documents if applicable.

Educational Qualification

Post Qualifying Degree
Production Manager B.Tech/BE/Equivalent as a Full-time Regular course from an AICTE/UGC-recognised Institution/College/University/Deemed University in Chemical Engineering, with minimum 60% marks.
Senior Production Manager B.Tech/BE/Equivalent as a Full-time Regular course from an AICTE/UGC-recognised Institution/College/University/Deemed University in Chemical Engineering, with minimum 60% marks.
Senior Manager (PBR-Marketing) B.Tech/BE/Equivalent (any discipline) as a Full-time Regular course from an AICTE/UGC-recognised Institution/College/University/Deemed University with minimum 60% marks, OR Science Graduate with MBA or equivalent as a Full-time Regular course from an AICTE/UGC-recognised Institution/College/University/Deemed University with minimum 60% marks.

Note: Candidates with a qualifying degree from a discipline other than Chemical Engineering are not eligible for Production Manager and Senior Production Manager posts. Any qualification acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance/Online mode is not eligible. Where marks are awarded as CGPA/GPA, the percentage will be arrived at as per the Institute/University's own conversion formula; the fraction of percentage arrived at will not be rounded off (i.e., 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%). Candidates who completed ME/M.Tech as part of an Integrated or Dual Degree programme are eligible, subject to the specific calculation rules in the official notification.

Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

Detailed Work Experience & Job Profile

Post Work Experience Required
Production Manager (Grade C) Minimum 10 years of post-qualification work experience in company(ies) having Poly Butadiene Rubber (PBR) units, including at least 5 years of producing Polybutadiene rubber in units with PBR production technology in India or abroad. Must include finalisation of Product Matrix, operation of PBR units, and organising repair/routine maintenance of PBR units.
Senior Production Manager (Grade D) Minimum 14 years of post-qualification work experience in company(ies) having PBR units, including at least 7 years of producing Polybutadiene rubber in units with PBR production technology in India or abroad. Same experience scope as Production Manager, at a senior/leadership level.
Senior Manager – PBR-Marketing (Grade D) Minimum 14 years of total post-qualification work experience with at least 7 years of relevant experience in rubber marketing or allied products, preferably in organisations catering to the tyre manufacturing industry, including exposure to synthetic rubber products such as PBR/SBR or similar elastomers.

Job responsibilities broadly cover: knowledge sharing on PBR production technology and finalisation of product matrix, technical specification preparation, operator training and knowledge transfer, pre-commissioning/commissioning support, catalyst loading and polymerization trials, troubleshooting process upsets, quality/energy optimisation, and compliance with safety regulations (for Production Manager and Senior Production Manager); and market development, sales/business development, customer relationship management, pricing strategy, marketing/promotion, and reporting (for Senior Manager – PBR-Marketing). Internships, teaching experience, part-time work, academic research, and short-term trainee/project experience are not considered relevant experience. Experience is counted only from the date of declaration of the qualifying degree result.

IOCL Reserved Category Guidelines

All 3 posts are Unreserved; therefore, no relaxation/concession in eligibility criteria is extended to EWS/OBC(NCL)/SC/ST candidates. However, such candidates must furnish supporting documents in the latest prescribed format if applying under a reserved category (for fee purposes and category-based verification):

  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): Certificate must be issued by the Competent Authority in the latest prescribed format, appear in the Central List of OBCs for the respective State, and be issued on or after 01.04.2026. Creamy layer candidates must apply as General. Maharashtra candidates need a valid Caste Validity Certificate; a self-undertaking is required at the time of Personal Interview.
  • EWS: Income and Asset Certificate must be valid for financial year 2026–27, based on income/asset verification for FY 2025–26, issued on or after 01.04.2026, with the candidate's photo pasted, signed, and stamped by the issuing authority.

IOCL Pay Scale & Remuneration 2026

Selected candidates will be placed on the pay scale below with the stated initial basic pay, plus Dearness Allowance and other allowances as per Corporation rules.

Other allowances/benefits include HRA/Subsidized Housing Accommodation (depending on place of posting), Medical facilities, Gratuity, Contributory Provident Fund, Group Personal Accident Insurance Scheme, Leave Encashment, Leave Travel Concession (LTC)/Leave Fare Assistance (LFA), Contributory Superannuation Benefit Fund Scheme, Conveyance Advance/Maintenance Reimbursement, and Performance Related Pay (PRP), as per Corporation rules. The gross valuation of remuneration indicated above is inclusive of PRP; actual remuneration may vary based on place of posting, Corporation performance, and individual appraisal.

Credit/debit card and bank transaction charges, if any, are borne by the candidate. Application fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances, and no chargeback can be claimed.

IOCL Selection Process 2026

  • Eligibility of candidates is verified prior to the Personal Interview; only candidates meeting the eligibility criteria and having uploaded relevant, valid documents proceed further.
  • Document Verification: Physical document verification of shortlisted candidates is conducted on the day of the Personal Interview.
  • Personal Interview: Post document verification, eligible shortlisted candidates are interviewed by Committee(s) for final selection.
  • Final selection and joining is subject to meeting the physical fitness criteria described in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME) Guidelines, available on the "Latest Job Opening" section of www.iocl.com. Candidates must meet PEME parameters for Technical Functions.

Selected candidates must execute a bond to serve the Corporation for a minimum period of 3 years from the date of joining.

Category Bond Amount
General Rs. Three Lakhs only
EWS/OBC(NCL)/SC/ST Rs. Fifty Thousand only

Selected candidates must join on the date mentioned in their Offer of Appointment, failing which IOCL reserves the right to cancel/withdraw the offer without further correspondence.

  • Scanned copy of a recent colour passport-size photograph, not older than 6 months
  • Scanned copy of signature
  • Class 10 Pass Certificate (as proof of Date of Birth)

  • Conversion certificate for CGPA-to-percentage, if applicable, at the time of Document Verification/Personal Interview
  • Any other documents indicated on the online portal

How to Apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026

  1. Read the detailed advertisement carefully and check your eligibility before applying online.
  2. Visit IOCL's official website, www.iocl.com, and go to the "Latest Job Opening" link at iocl.com/latest-job-opening.
  3. Register your email ID and mobile number on the online portal (these cannot be changed after registration, so ensure they remain active for at least 1 year from the date of application).
  4. Fill in the online application form with correct and complete information, verifying entries carefully as no changes are permitted after submission.
  5. Upload the required documents: recent colour passport-size photograph, signature, Class 10 certificate, work experience documents, and category certificate (if applicable).
  6. Capture your live photo through the portal's in-built camera feature as instructed, ensuring your appearance matches your uploaded photo and your actual appearance at the time of interview, if shortlisted.
  7. Pay the applicable application fee online through the integrated payment gateway (not applicable for SC/ST candidates).
  8. On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated; download and retain a printout of the e-Receipt and the online application form (in PDF) for future reference. Do not send this printout to IOCL.
  9. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria may apply for only one position; applying for more than one position will result in summary rejection of all applications.

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates must ensure that all particulars furnished in the online application are complete and correct in all respects; suppression of facts or furnishing false information may lead to cancellation of candidature or termination of appointment, even after joining.
  • Mere registration on the portal does not mean the candidate meets the eligibility criteria; this must be established by producing relevant and valid documents in original at the time of document verification.
  • Any canvassing, during or after the selection process, will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates presently employed in Government Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer at the time of interview, if shortlisted.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum, corrigendum, or time extension will be hosted on the "Careers – Latest Job Opening" section of www.iocl.com; candidates should check the website regularly.
  • In case of multiple applications for the same position, the latest application form will be considered and earlier ones summarily rejected.
  • The decision of Management is final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance/rejection of application, mode of selection, and cancellation of the recruitment process (in part or full).
  • IOCL reserves the right to cancel this recruitment process at its sole discretion at any stage without offering any reason.
  • Recruitment in IOCL is notified only in leading newspapers, Employment News/Rozgar Samachar, and on the official website www.iocl.com — candidates should be aware of recruitment fraud.

Stipend payable by RCF is paid monthly on a fixed date. Stipend payable by BOAT is disbursed directly to ACT Apprentices, and RCF is not responsible for any delay or non-payment by BOAT. Additionally, RCF provides morning breakfast, tea, and a vegetarian lunch thali in the company canteen during training (no reimbursement if not availed), OPD-basis medical facilities at RCF Hospital for trainees themselves, and uniform and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as per company policy. No transportation facility or reimbursement is provided.

RCF Apprentice Posting & Training Timing

  • Apprentices will be trained at RCF's units at Trombay, Mumbai, or Thal, Raigad District, as per the company's requirements.
  • Candidates must select either Trombay or Thal in the "Posting At" drop-down while applying; this choice cannot be changed once selected. Final posting depends on the approved intake quota of the respective unit.
  • The place of posting is non-transferable throughout the apprenticeship training period; no transfer requests between units will be entertained.
Category of Apprentice Daily Training Timing (excluding weekly off/holiday)
Graduate Apprentices 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Technician and Trade Apprentices 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

Late attendance or punching results in a proportionate stipend deduction. All ACT Apprentices must register on the Face Recognition-based Attendance System and record both IN and OUT punches daily; missing punches will be treated as absence for that day, subject to regularisation under applicable rules.

RCF Apprentice Selection Process 2026-27

  1. A merit list is drawn based on the percentage criteria and applicable reservation, using marks in the prescribed essential educational qualification. Where CGPA/CPI or grades are awarded, the equivalent percentage (as per the University/Institute's own norms) must be indicated in the application, with a supporting certificate submitted at document verification.
  2. Candidates from the merit list are called for Document Verification.
  3. Candidates are appointed as Apprentice Trainees only after successful document verification and approval of their Apprenticeship Contract on the respective portal (NATS/NAPS). Trainees are expected to join upon contract approval; failure to report on the stipulated date may lead to cancellation of candidature.
  4. In case of a tie in merit-list marks (even after considering decimals), the candidate with the higher qualification is ranked higher; if the qualification is the same, the candidate with more marks in the preceding educational qualification is ranked higher.

How to Apply for RCF Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

  1. Visit the company's website: www.rcfltd.com.
  2. Click on "RECRUITMENT" and then "ENGAGEMENT OF APPRENTICES – 2026-27."
  3. View the full advertisement and details, and read the instructions and terms & conditions carefully before applying.
  4. Click on "I Accept" and then "Apply Online" to open the application form.
  5. Choose your posting area, "Trombay" or "Thal," from the drop-down.
  6. Keep a scanned passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, up to 75 KB) and signature (JPG/JPEG, up to 25 KB) ready to upload.
  7. Fill out the application form completely, then click "SAVE/SUBMIT."
  8. After successful submission, the application form will be generated. Click "Print" to print it - this printed form must be produced at the document verification stage, but candidates are not required to send a hard copy to RCF.

Also Read: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 207 Specialist Cadre Officers Posts

Registration on Apprenticeship Portals

  • Candidates aspiring for Trade Apprenticeship (NAPS) must register on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
  • Candidates aspiring for Technician, Diploma-holder, or Graduate/Degree Apprenticeships must register as a student on nats.education.gov.in.

Documents Required for RCF Apprentice Application

At the Time of Document Verification

  • Latest passport-size photographs
  • Updated PAN card
  • Updated Aadhaar card
  • A self-operated primary bank account in the candidate's own name (excluding Postal Bank accounts), DBT-enabled and Aadhaar-linked, for stipend credit
  • Mark sheets of all years/semesters or passing certificates in the qualifying examination
  • SSC certificate / Birth certificate / School leaving certificate / passport (any one, as proof of age)

At the Time of Reporting (if selected)

  • Latest passport-size photographs
  • Proof of age (SSC certificate/Birth certificate/School leaving certificate)
  • Leaving certificate for SSC, HSC, and Graduation, with Student ID
  • Educational qualification mark sheets and certificates (10th, 12th, Graduation - all years/semesters)
  • Certificate from the University/Institution on the equivalent percentage of marks in the qualifying examination (if CGPA/CPI is used)
  • Medical fitness certificate from a Registered Medical Officer/Practitioner of a Government or Municipal Hospital, in the prescribed format (Annexure A)
  • Caste certificate, for SC/ST candidates (Annexure B)
  • OBC (NCL) certificate and caste certificate in Central Government format, for OBC (NCL) candidates
  • EWS certificate, for EWS candidates
  • Certificate for children/family members of the victims of the 1984 riots, where applicable

Also Read: IBPS RRB CRP-XV Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 13706 Officer & Office Assistant Posts

RCF Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Important Instructions

  • Online applications are accepted only from 4 September 2026 to 20 September 2026 (both dates included).
  • The email address and mobile number provided in the application must remain valid and functional at least from the date of submission.
  • Selected apprentices must possess an Aadhaar-linked and seeded bank account in their own name (preferably a nationalised bank with internet banking) to receive stipend from BOAT and RCF.
  • Candidates must mandatorily possess PAN and Aadhaar cards at the time of reporting; the name on the Aadhaar card must match all educational qualification documents.
  • Only the medical certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure A) will be accepted.
  • Candidates must apply for only ONE discipline/trade, strictly as per their eligibility; applying for more than one discipline/trade will lead to rejection of all applications submitted.
  • Applicants are not required to send or submit documents at the time of applying online; documents are verified only when called for by RCF.
  • Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to selection; selection follows the criteria and procedure prescribed by the company, which may raise the minimum eligibility criteria to manage the number of candidates selected.
  • Furnishing wrong or false information in the application is a disqualification; RCF is not responsible for any resulting disqualification.
  • Apprentices not completing the full training period, or absent without valid grounds under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961, will have their contract terminated without notice, no certificate will be issued, and stipend recovery may apply.
  • Any legal proceedings relating to this advertisement or an application can be instituted only in Mumbai courts/forums.
  • RCF reserves the right to cancel the advertisement and/or the selection process at any stage, without assigning any reason; any changes will be reflected only on the official website www.rcfltd.com.
  • Posts earmarked in the advertisement may vary by up to 10% depending on response, to maintain the apprentice engagement quota; if response is insufficient, applications may be considered on a first-come, first-served basis among eligible online applicants.
  • The Company has no obligation to offer regular employment to apprentices upon or after completion of training; apprentices have no right or claim to regular employment based on this apprenticeship at any stage, and it creates no liability or obligation on RCF to provide employment during or after the training period.
  • The decision of RCF Limited Management is final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, and cancellation of the selection process, in part or full; no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • For any communication, candidates must email [email protected] only; no telephonic calls or personal visits will be entertained, and attempts to do so may lead to disqualification.

State Bank of India (SBI) has invited online applications from eligible Indian citizens for the engagement of Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO) on contract basis in its Wealth Management vertical, under Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/23. The Bank has notified 207 tentative vacancies across seven posts - Zonal Head (Retail), Regional Head, Relationship Manager–Team Lead, Investment Specialist, Investment Officer, VP Wealth, and AVP Wealth - spread across 17 Circles nationwide. Eligible graduate candidates meeting the post-specific age and experience criteria can apply online through https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings from 04-09-2026 to 25-09-2026. Selection is through shortlisting followed by interview and CTC negotiation, with contracts running for 5 years.

The notification was issued by the Central Recruitment & Promotion Department, SBI Corporate Centre, Mumbai, dated 04-09-2026.

SBI SCO Application Fee

The application fee and intimation charges (non-refundable) are ₹750 for UR/EWS/OBC candidates; there is no fee for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Fees must be paid online through the payment gateway integrated with the application, using Debit Card, Credit Card, or Internet Banking. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded or adjusted for any other examination or selection.

SBI SCO Selection Process

  • Shortlisting: mere fulfilment of minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview; the shortlisting committee decides the parameters and number of candidates called.
  • Interview: one or more rounds of personal, telephonic, or video interview, carrying 100 marks; the qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.
  • CTC Negotiation: conducted individually with shortlisted candidates, at the time of interview or after completion of the interview process.
  • Merit List: prepared in descending order based on interview scores only; candidates tied at the cut-off mark are ranked by age, in descending order.

How to Apply Online for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and download the detailed advertisement, CRPD/SCO/2026-27/23.
  2. Register online through the link provided, keeping a valid email ID active until the declaration of results.
  3. Scan and upload your latest photograph and signature as specified; the application will not register without these.
  4. Upload all relevant documents, including resume, ID proof, age proof, caste certificate, PwBD certificate (if applicable), educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, and biodata.
  5. Fill the application carefully, note the system-generated registration number and password, and pay the application fee online through the integrated payment gateway.
  6. Take a printout of the submitted application form and the fee e-receipt for your records; no changes are allowed after final submission.

Candidates should apply well before the closing date, 25-09-2026, to avoid last-minute technical issues. Hard copies of the application and documents need not be sent to the Bank.

SBI SCO Recruitment 2026 – Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for more than one post if they otherwise fulfil all eligibility criteria for each post.
  • Teaching and training experience will not be counted for eligibility.
  • Candidates working in Government/Quasi-Government offices, PSUs, Nationalized Banks, Financial Institutions, and SBI Group companies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Candidates previously issued offer letters in earlier Wealth Management & Premier Banking (WBPM) recruitment exercises but who did not join, or who previously resigned after being engaged on contract for posts in this advertisement, are debarred from applying for 2 years from the date of non-joining/resignation.
  • The call letter/interview advice will be sent by email only; no hard copy will be sent.
  • All revisions/corrigenda will be hosted on the Bank's website only.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely, or for any particular post, at any stage without assigning reasons.
  • Any legal proceedings arising from this recruitment fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Mumbai.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

Not every sarkari job requires a degree. Use the qualification and state filters below to sarkari job find openings that actually match your eligibility, instead of scrolling through listings you don't qualify for.

Graduate and postgraduate-level sarkari jobs include SSC CGL, Bank PO, UPSC Civil Services, and various state PCS exams. See qualification-matched listings on our Graduate Jobs page.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

What is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Forest Department Recruitment Process Timeline

The recruitment process generally follows the stages below:

  • Notification Released
  • Online Application Starts
  • Application Last Date
  • Admit Card Release
  • Written Examination
  • Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination
  • Final Merit List
  • Appointment

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Post Pay Level / Pay Scale Approximate Gross Salary (Monthly)
Forest Guard / Field Guard Pay Level 3 ₹28,000 – ₹35,000
Forester Pay Level 4–5 ₹35,000 – ₹45,000
Range Forest Officer Pay Level 7–8 ₹50,000 – ₹65,000
Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) Pay Level 10 ₹70,000 – ₹95,000
Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer Pay Level 10 and above ₹80,000+ (with allowances)

Figures are indicative and vary by state pay commission; always confirm exact pay scale from the official notification.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

How to Apply for Forest Department Recruitment 2026 (Apply Online)

Follow these steps to complete your forest department recruitment 2026 apply online process:

  1. Visit the official website of the respective state Forest Department or recruitment board (link provided in the notification table above)
  2. Register using your mobile number and email ID to generate login credentials
  3. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and category details
  4. Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and required certificates
  5. Pay the application fee online via net banking, debit card, or UPI (fee varies by category and state)
  6. Review all entered details carefully before final submission
  7. Submit the form and download/print the confirmation page for future reference

Documents Required & Application Fee

Documents required:

  • Passport-size photograph and signature (scanned, as per specified format)
  • Educational certificates and mark sheets
  • Date of birth proof (10th certificate or birth certificate)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), if applicable
  • Ex-servicemen discharge certificate, if applying under that quota
  • Domicile/residence certificate, where required by the state

Application fee: Typically ranges from ₹200–₹1,000 depending on the state and category, with fee concessions or exemptions commonly available for SC/ST, PwBD, and ex-servicemen candidates.
